cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
binary=cli.build()
d={}
for i in range(3):
    hi=0x20010db800000000; lo=(i<<58)|(1<<57)
    hi,lo=pyref.norm(hi,lo,70); d[(hi,lo,70)]=i+1
ops=[['put','%016x%016x'%(k[0],k[1]),k[2],v] for k,v in d.items()]+[['save'],['load_saved',0]]
res=cli.results({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]},binary)[0]
snap=res['snapshots'][0]
print('bitmaps',snap['bitmaps'],'nexthops',snap['nexthops'],'cells',snap['cells'],'loads',res['loads'])
print('pyref validates:', pyref.validate(snap))
# show the root record
w=int(snap['banks'][0][0],16)
print('type',pyref.field(w,0,3),'bmp',pyref.field(w,3,22),'bid',pyref.field(w,25,16),'base',pyref.field(w,41,22))
for i in range(6):
    v=pyref.field(w,63+32*i,32); print('  child',i,'key',v&63,'stage',(v>>6)&15,'cell',v>>10)
PY
